{{Top|leg}}
The '''K'ntarr family''' was a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] family, part of the [[Royal House of Rydonni]], that ruled over [[Rydonni Prime]] at some point after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. This family included [[King/Legends|King]] [[Rilvvan K'ntarr]] and his daughter, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kalieva K'ntarr]].
